Internal Note — RCS-28327 Root Cause Analysis

Correction to prior investigation: The earlier investigation was run against the wrong client schema (ARDM_112 = Giant Food / Stop & Shop, a different Ahold Delhaize banner — Store 2667 and TID 2608025570789970641 never existed there). The correct client is c046dhz (ARDMPROD.ARDM_046 = Delhaize, banner "FOOD LION").

  1. The data pipeline is working correctly.
    Confirmed in ARDMPROD.ARDM_046.ARDM_ITEMDISCOUNT for TID 2608025570789970641: the discount row has CODE = 'loyalty discount', TYPE = 'other', REASON = null. This is set intentionally by our parser (pyardm/us/c046dhz/ardm/python/pd_pos_parser.py:777,842) when it detects an AdvancedFrequentShopper/FrequentShopper POS discount event. So our mapping correctly identifies this as a loyalty discount — this is not a mapping/pipeline bug.

  2. Root cause is in Secure's display/enumeration layer.
    Client 46 runs on ARDM V3 (text-based itemdiscount schema: type/code/classification/reason/method). The itemdiscount.searchable definition's discount-type display field resolves its shown text via:

Platform.GetExcelReferenceData(type, "/system/ebr/crdm/store/2_0/enumerations/crdm pos enumerations.xlsx", "ItemDiscountType")

This is a legacy CRDM 2.0 enumeration workbook path.

  1. That workbook does not exist for this cli
    Confirmed via secure.Repo on client 46's Platform DB — querying that exact VirtualFilePath returns 0 rows. So the lookup fails silently, and the description column comes back blank. This is not isolated to loyalty discounts or to a
    single store — it affects every item discoun the enum source it needs simply isn't there.

Working theory: this is a gap from client 46's migration to ARDM V3 — the CRDM enumeration workbook was never
created/uploaded for this client (other legaave their own copy at this same path).

Pending validation: haven't yet 100% confirmt_type is literally what renders as the "Item Discount Description" column the customer sees (vs. a differently named field) — quick check via Composer (open the saved search, inspect the column's bound field ID) before communicating a fix externally.

Recommendation: this is a config/content gap, not a code defect — needs whoever manages client 46's Secure content
(Solutions/Implementation, likely whoever ralient) to create the missing enumerationworkbook with the correct type → description mappings. Also worth flagging to Engineering/DataOps as a possible systemic risk for other clients migrated V2→V3, in case the same enumeration file wasn't carried over for them either.

","created":"2026-08-27T18:19:08.155-0400","updated":"2026-08-27T18:19:08.155-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"jsdPublic":true},{"id":"3327904","author":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"body":"

Root cause investigation on this ticket, comment by Edwin Garzon on August 20, found that the reported symptom is not a data pipeline defect. Fifteen days passed since that finding with no action taken on it.

Environment. Production, Secure 5.4, client c046dhz, ARDMPROD.ARDM_046, Delhaize banner Food Lion.

Findings confirmed by Edwin Garzon on August 20. Transaction 2608025570789970641 carries CODE equal to loyalty discount in ARDM_ITEMDISCOUNT. TYPE for the same row is other. The parser sets these values intentionally in pyardm/us/c046dhz/ardm/python/pd_pos_parser.py at lines 777 and 842 when it detects an AdvancedFrequentShopper or FrequentShopper POS event. The transaction data is correct.

Client 46 runs ARDM V3 with a text based itemdiscount schema. The Item Discount Description field in Composer resolves its text through Platform.GetExcelReferenceData pointed at /system/ebr/crdm/store/2_0/enumerations/crdm pos enumerations.xlsx. A SELECT against secure.Repo for that exact VirtualFilePath on client 46's Platform DB returned zero rows.

Validation completed today. Composer confirms Item Discount Description is a single computed field, not user selectable between type, code or reason. A SELECT against EnumerationReferenceData for client 46 confirms the itemdiscounttype enumeration already exists there, with keys employee, free, loyalty, manual_price and other.

Conclusion, first point. The itemdiscounttype enumeration for client 46 already exists in EnumerationReferenceData. The field definition still calls the CRDM 2.0 xlsx path instead of that table. This definition was left behind in the V2 to V3 migration and it can affect every client migrated the same way, not only client 46.

Conclusion, second point. Redirecting the definition to EnumerationReferenceData does not close this ticket by itself. TYPE for this transaction is other, and other maps to OTHER in EnumerationReferenceData, not to Loyalty Discount. The legacy 3.5 receipt for the same transaction prints Reason: Loyalty Discount. Confirm whether AdvancedFrequentShopper and FrequentShopper POS events should set TYPE to loyalty instead of other in the parser. Without that second fix the column stops being blank and shows OTHER, which does not match what the customer saw before the upgrade.

Precedent. RCS-27761, same client 46, same reporter, Tender Check Amount blank on Payroll Check tender. Nikita Rathore found MediaNo 4 was missing because it originally mapped to paper Food Stamps. Engineering fixed it with a PR adding MediaNo 4. Same symptom family, an enumeration value missing at the platform level, resolved by Engineering.

Scope. Edwin states this is not isolated to loyalty discounts or to one store. It affects every item discount on this client where the type field renders through this same lookup.

Troubleshooting performed. Edwin Garzon queried ARDM_ITEMDISCOUNT and secure.Repo directly against production, read only, on August 20. I confirmed the EnumerationReferenceData content and the Composer field structure today, also read only. AI assisted in interpreting the EnumerationReferenceData output and the Composer field structure, cross referencing them against Edwin's August 20 findings, before this comment was drafted. No conversation with Engineering happened outside this ticket before this comment.

What I need. Update the Item Discount Description definition to resolve against EnumerationReferenceData instead of the CRDM 2.0 xlsx path for client 46. Confirm whether the same stale definition exists on other clients migrated from V2 to V3. Confirm whether TYPE should be loyalty instead of other for AdvancedFrequentShopper and FrequentShopper events in the client 46 parser.

","created":"2026-09-07T03:31:56.988-0400","updated":"2026-09-07T03:36:01.243-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"5f45724e91e67a003fef5920","displayName":"Shandana Khan"},"jsdPublic":false},{"id":"3349648","author":{"accountId":"712020:e12c6a7a-199d-4502-a12c-28ec14c0fb12","displayName":"Juan Ramirez"},"body":"

Correcting the record on the earlier analysis first: the missing CRDM 2.0 workbook is a real defect, but it is not what Becky reported.

Client 46 renames these fields in arpfiles repo/46/seed/secure_Resource.json:

  • ItemDiscountDiscountType → "Item Discount Type"

  • ItemDiscountReason → "Item Discount Description"

So the column the customer sees as "Item Discount Description" is bound to itemdiscount_reason, not itemdiscount_type. In platform/system/ebr/ardm/store/3_0/searchable/itemdiscount.searchable, itemdiscount_reason binds directly to <Description>reason</Description> with no <Display> block — it renders the raw value. REASON is null for this row, so the cell is blank. No enumeration is involved in that column. The GetExcelReferenceData(... "ItemDiscountType") lookup belongs to the other column ("Item Discount Type"). It is genuinely broken for client 46 and deserves its own ticket, but it is not the cause of what Becky reported.

Root cause of the null REASON — an ordering bug in the parser

SnowTime repo, pyardm/us/c046dhz/ardm/python/pd_pos_parser.py:

line

code

447

active_loyalty_card_no = None — initialised before the ticket loop

464

single pass over the ticket nodes, in document order

775 / 840

'type': 'loyalty' if active_loyalty_card_no else 'other', 'reason': None

1546

active_loyalty_card_no = card_no — assigned ~700 lines later

When the Clubcard node comes after the AdvancedFrequentShopper/FrequentShopper discount nodes, the discount row is built while active_loyalty_card_no is still None → type='other' and reason stays null. Becky's legacy receipt shows LOYALTY CARD: 46128750272 Keyed — manually keyed, which normally happens at tender time, i.e. after the items. The if active_loyalty_card_no guard came from RCS-26936 (resolved 10 Jul 2026), which fixed the opposite symptom. This transaction is 2 Aug, after that fix, so this is a live ordering defect and not stale data.

A proper fix needs the loyalty context resolved after the whole ticket is parsed (second pass / deferred assignment), plus a pipeline re-run to backfill history.

Correction on the precedent: RCS-27761 was not fixed by Engineering. It was assigned to Nikita Rathore, resolution "Support Data Team Resolved - BackEnd Update", fixed in pd_pos_parser.py on branch nrathore/bug/RCS-27761-payroll-check-tender-type. Same file, same team — which is precisely why this one belongs there too. Thanks to Shandana for flagging that.

What Engineering has already shipped

Receipt view only — arpfiles PR #57678, client 46, repo/46/system/ebr/ardm/store/3_0/viewer/detail-panel.html:

- {{discount.reason}}\n+ {{discount.reason || (discount.code === 'UNKNOWN' ? '' : discount.code)}}

Verified on staging 15 Sep: the discount line now reads loyalty discount $0.49 (20%) where it previously showed only $0.49 (20%), and the PDF export shows it too.

Still open — for the Support Data Team

The "Item Discount Description" column in the grid is still blank, because it is itemdiscount_reason and REASON is still null in ARDM. That cannot be fixed from Secure — it needs the parser change above. A platform-level Coalesce on the searchable would only mask the display, and it would apply to every V3 client, so it is not the right fix.

Requesting redirect to the Support Data Team, same queue as RCS-27761.
